name: Brick Blitz
tagline: Smash the wall. Catch the chaos.
description: A portrait-first 3D brick-breaker built with Three.js. Fifty levels per world across ten worlds, forty power-ups including the bad ones, twenty-five brick types that change how you aim, and a boss at the end of every world. The ball runs on a fixed-step deterministic simulation with swept collisions, so a hit is a hit on every screen size. Bricks are real 3D geometry with debris, particles and stress-tested specials: shield plating you have to burn off, colour locks that ignore ordinary hits, portals that relocate the ball, gravity wells that bend it, and switch bricks that open every bulkhead on the level.
highlights: 500 levels across ten themed worlds, each one structurally validated in CI before it ships
40 power-ups with deterministic conflict rules: tiny beats mega, speed is capped, the ball swarm is capped
25 brick types with real behaviours, not just different colours: portals, gravity wells, switches, shields and armoured cores
Ten bosses with three health phases and telegraphed attacks, from the Brick Titan to the Blitz King
Deterministic swept collision physics, a fixed 120 Hz step, and portrait-first touch controls
howToPlay: Drag anywhere in the lower half of the screen to slide the paddle. On desktop use the mouse or arrow keys.
Tap LAUNCH. Where the ball lands on the paddle sets the angle: centre goes straight up, edges go wide.
Read the glyphs: shields need fire, colour locks need electricity, bulkheads never break. Catch capsules and avoid the red-ringed ones.
Break the objective, then the boss core. Stars come from score, not from speed.
levels: 500 levels · 10 worlds + endless, survival, boss rush, daily, zen and 8 challenges
